caption:
You spend hours turning meeting notes and scope docs into polished client proposals. Gemini 4 Argon cuts that work down to minutes. It reads your rough project context and builds a structured deck you can send straight to prospects.

Open the Gemini app. Paste this exact prompt:
"Act as a senior consultant. I will paste rough project notes, client goals, and scope details. Turn them into a structured client proposal deck. Include an executive summary, deliverables, timeline, pricing table, and next steps. Keep the tone professional and direct. Output as slide-by-slide markdown."

This workflow runs in the Gemini mobile app. You need a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription to access it. The free tier does not support this feature. It handles structure and drafting well, but you still need to verify pricing numbers and adjust tone to match your brand.

Save this reel for your next client pitch. Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
